52 weeks = 364 days.  
364 days + 1 day = 365 days.  
365 days after 1291-02-15 is 1292-02-14 (since 1292 is a leap year? No, 1292 is divisible by 4, but 1291 not a leap year; 1292 is a leap year, so Feb 29 exists, but we start from Feb 15 1291, add 365 days = Feb 14 1292).  
Check: 1291-02-15 + 365 days = 1292-02-14.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1292-02-14
